submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires on the token that completes a locally predictable 2-3-token run: the predicate verb after a subject NP (cat->sat, court->ruled, there->lived), the noun closing a selective collocation (last/next->year), or the function word, operator, or punctuation closing a frequent frame (twice->in, time->on, from/and->the, numpy->as, active->=, a->comma, charges->period). It stays near baseline (~0.02) on sentence-initial tokens and on surprising constituent-starts (e.g. a content noun after a determiner, or an arbitrary word in the same slot).
